The world & variant

Where it belongs

Swords, Staves, Cups and Coins each have fourteen cards. The older Drive workbook and the repository’s expanded handoff preserve the original character assignments.

The companion

No dedicated bot verified

No tarot-reading or deck-play bot was verified. Planned game AI in Paragon-Reborn is separate from this tarot design.

The visual language

Design & artwork

The repository contains card-by-card illustration briefs and a companion-book artifact. This is a design handoff, not evidence of seventy-eight finished illustrations or a cleared merchandise edition.

The design handoff

The 78-card assignment index.

These character assignments are narrative and symbolic design choices. They do not establish character strength or gameplay balance. Card-specific illustration briefs, upright and reversed meanings remain in the source handoff.
